/* selectAddress - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT
E.USER_ID, E.FLNM_ENCPT, E.SXDC_SE_CD, E.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT, E.EML_ADDR_ENCPT, E.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT, E.UNT_SYSTEM, E.INST_NM, E.MEMBER_TYPE, E.MEMBER_NO
FROM
( SELECT
D.USER_ID, ISRY_APP_DEC_B64(C.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM_ENCPT, C.SXDC_SE_CD, ISRY_APP_DEC_B64(C.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT, ISRY_APP_DEC_B64(C.EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS EML_ADDR_ENCPT, ISRY_APP_DEC_B64(C.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT) AS MSNGR_ID_ENCPT,
(SELECT J.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 J /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE J.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD' AND J.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = L.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD) AS UNT_SYSTEM,
L.INST_NO AS INST_NM,
'종사자' AS MEMBER_TYPE, C.ENFSN_NO AS MEMBER_NO
FROM SCA100 C /* 종사자 */ LEFT JOIN SAA200 D /* 사용자 */ ON D.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO LEFT JOIN SCA300 F /* 개인정보 */ ON F.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = C.INDV_IDNTFC_NO LEFT JOIN SAB230 G /*사용자별기관권한*/ ON G.USER_ID = D.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SAA000 L /* 통합기관 */ ON L.INST_NO = G.INST_NO
WHERE C.DEL_YN = 'N' AND (D.JOIN_APRV_YN IS NULL OR D.JOIN_APRV_YN = 'Y')
AND C.FLNM_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{flnm})
AND C.EML_ADDR_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{emlAddr})
AND C.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{mblTelno})
AND D.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{userId} || '%'
AND L.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{untTaskwkSeCd}
AND G.INST_NO = #{instNo}
) E
AND E.INST_NM LIKE '%' || #{instNm} || '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT
D1.USER_ID, C##RG.DEC_B64(C1.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM_ENCPT, C1.SXDC_SE_CD, C##RG.DEC_B64(C1.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT, C##RG.DEC_B64(C1.EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS EML_ADDR_ENCPT, '' AS MSNGR_ID_ENCPT,
'' AS UNT_SYSTEM, '' AS INST_NM,
CASE C1.YNGBGS_PRTCR_SE_CD WHEN 'Y' THEN '청소년' ELSE '보호자' END AS MEMBER_TYPE, C1.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO AS MEMBER_NO
FROM SCA200 C1 /* 청소년 보호자 */ LEFT JOIN SAA200 D1 /* 사용자 */ ON D1.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = C1.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO LEFT JOIN SCA300 F1 /* 개인정보 */ ON F1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = C1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO
WHERE C1.DEL_YN = 'N' AND (D1.JOIN_APRV_YN IS NULL OR D1.JOIN_APRV_YN = 'Y')
AND C1.FLNM_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{flnm})
AND C1.EML_ADDR_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{emlAddr})
AND C1.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{mblTelno})
AND D1.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{userId} || '%'
AND 1=2
AND 1=2
AND 1=2
UNION ALL
SELECT
D2.USER_ID, C2.INST_NM AS FLNM_ENCPT, '' AS SXDC_SE_CD, C##RG.DEC_B64(C2.PIC_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT, C##RG.DEC_B64(C2.PIC_EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS EML_ADDR_ENCPT, '' AS MSNGR_ID_ENCPT,
(SELECT J2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 J2 /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE J2.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD' AND J2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C2.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD) AS UNT_SYSTEM,
C2.INST_NM,
'기관' AS MEMBER_TYPE, TO_CHAR(C2.INST_NO) AS MEMBER_NO
FROM SAA000 C2 /* 통합 기관 */ JOIN SAB230 D3 /* 사용자기관 */ ON C2.INST_NO = D3.INST_NO JOIN SAA200 D2 /* 사용자 */ ON D2.USER_ID = D3.USER_ID
WHERE C2.APRV_YN = 'Y' AND C2.DEL_YN = 'N' AND (D2.JOIN_APRV_YN IS NULL OR D2.JOIN_APRV_YN = 'Y')
AND C2.INST_NM LIKE '%' || #{flnmNormal} || '%'
AND C2.PIC_EML_ADDR_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{emlAddr})
AND C2.PIC_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{mblTelno})
AND D2.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{userId} || '%'
AND C2.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{untTaskwkSeCd}
AND C2.INST_NO = #{instNo}
AND C2.INST_NM LIKE '%' || #{instNm} || '%'

SELECT E.USER_ID, E.UNT_SYSTEM, E.INST_NM, E.MEMBER_TYPE, E.MEMBER_NO, E.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, E.GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD, E.INDV_IDNTFC_NO, E.QLFC_SE_CD, E.DEL_YN, E.FLNM_ENCPT, E.FLNM, E.BRTH_YMD, E.SXDC_SE_CD, E.WRD_TELNO, E.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT, E.MBL_TELNO, E.EML_ADDR_ENCPT, E.EML_ADDR, E.SNS_SE_CD, E.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT, E.MSNGR_ID, E.QLFC_INFO_MNG_NO, E.NCKN_NM, E.ATFINO, E.CNSLTNT_USE_VCATN_DAYCNT, E.CNSLTNT_USE_PSBLTY_YRYC_DAYCNT, E.TASKWK_TYPE_INST_NO, E.SRASH_WRT_YN, E.SRASH_WRT_BGNG_YMD, E.SRASH_WRT_END_YMD, E.DSCSN_PRFMNC_HSTR_BGNG_YMD, E.DSCSN_PRFMNC_HSTR_END_YMD, E.VCATN_DAYCNT, E.ERP_EMPLA_NO, E.INST_NO, E.INST_NM, E.DEPT_CD, E.JBPS_NM, E.ISTDR_YN, E.JNCMP_YMD, E.RETIRE_YMD, E.FRST_RGTR_ID, TO_CHAR(E.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_DT, E.LAST_MDFR_ID, TO_CHAR(E.LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM ( SELECT
D.USER_ID,
(SELECT J.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 J /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE J.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD' AND J.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = H.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD) AS UNT_SYSTEM,
(SELECT L.INST_NM FROM SAA000 L /* 통합기관 */ WHERE L.INST_NO = G.INST_NO) AS INST_NM,
'종사자' AS MEMBER_TYPE,
C.ENFSN_NO AS MEMBER_NO, H.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, G.GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD, C.INDV_IDNTFC_NO, C.QLFC_SE_CD, C.DEL_YN, C.FLNM_ENCPT, C##RG.DEC_B64(C.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM, C.BRTH_YMD, C.SXDC_SE_CD, C.WRD_TELNO, C.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT, C##RG.DEC_B64(C.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO, C.EML_ADDR_ENCPT, C##RG.DEC_B64(C.EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS EML_ADDR, C.SNS_SE_CD, C.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT, C##RG.DEC_B64(C.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT) AS MSNGR_ID, C.QLFC_INFO_MNG_NO, C.NCKN_NM, C.ATFINO, C.CNSLTNT_USE_VCATN_DAYCNT, C.CNSLTNT_USE_PSBLTY_YRYC_DAYCNT, C.TASKWK_TYPE_INST_NO, C.SRASH_WRT_YN, C.SRASH_WRT_BGNG_YMD, C.SRASH_WRT_END_YMD, C.DSCSN_PRFMNC_HSTR_BGNG_YMD, C.DSCSN_PRFMNC_HSTR_END_YMD, C.VCATN_DAYCNT, C.ERP_EMPLA_NO, H.INST_NO AS INST_NO, C.OGDP_DEPT_CD AS DEPT_CD, C.JBPS_NM, C.ISTDR_YN, C.JNCMP_YMD, C.RETIRE_YMD, C.FRST_RGTR_ID, C.FRST_REG_DT, C.LAST_MDFR_ID, C.LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM SCA100 C /* 종사자 */ LEFT JOIN SAA200 D /* 사용자 */ ON D.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO LEFT JOIN SCA300 F /* 개인정보 */ ON F.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = C.INDV_IDNTFC_NO LEFT JOIN SAB230 G /*사용자별 기관 권한*/ ON G.USER_ID = D.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SAA000 H /*통합기관*/ ON G.INST_NO = H.INST_NO
WHERE C.DEL_YN = 'N' AND (D.JOIN_APRV_YN IS NULL OR D.JOIN_APRV_YN = 'Y') AND D.USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND H.APRV_YN = 'Y' AND H.DEL_YN = 'N' AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN NVL(H.APLCN_BGNG_YMD,'19000101') AND NVL(H.APLCN_END_YMD,'99991231') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN NVL(C.JNCMP_YMD,'19000101') AND NVL(C.RETIRE_YMD,'99991231')
AND C.FLNM_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{flnm})
AND C.EML_ADDR_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{emlAddr})
AND C.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{mblTelno})
AND C.WRD_TELNO = #{wrdTelno}
AND LOWER(D.USER_ID) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{userId}) || '%'
AND H.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{untTaskwkSeCd}
AND H.INST_NO = #{instNo}
) E
AND E.INST_NM LIKE '%' || #{instNm} || '%'
